cases.name: Brazil_to_Germany
cases.user_content: Which continent is the country with the city of Rio de Janeiro on, and what is that country's three-letter currency code? Reply only as '<continent>; <currency code>'.

cases.name: arithmetic_control
cases.user_content: Someone from Munich asks: what is 2 + 2, and is that sum odd or even? Reply only as '<sum>; <odd or even>'.
